title: Independently audit the bounded eleven-wallet Helius recency and aggregate-statistics read
objective: Independently and read-only audit SOL-HELIUS-MANUAL-WALLET-RECENCY-STATS-LIVE-001. Confirm that its tracked specification freezes exactly the eleven Owner-supplied wallet inputs; that the underlying strict Solana address normalization rejects non-Base58 or non-32-byte values; that the report records only frozen wallet address, user-provided-unverified label, latest/oldest date availability, aggregate count availability, bounded-page completeness, slot availability and stable safe warning codes; and that the report accurately limits its conclusion to a degraded, one-attempt Helius-only read. Verify that no raw payload, credential, credential-bearing URL, transaction signature, counterparty, token mint, arbitrary provider text, PnL, realized profit, win rate, wallet classification, clustering, CA linkage, holder concentration, creator/Dev history, complete-history or token-quality claim is present. This is a read-only audit: do not execute any provider request, retry, scheduler, database/cache/queue, trade, signing, swap, transaction, or other live action. The ignored Harness run manifest must not be declared as a DONE-task input artifact; the audit conclusion must stand on tracked task, report, ledger and source evidence only.
forbidden_actions: Do not execute Helius, GMGN, Dune, Chain.fm or any other provider request, and do not inspect, expose or rotate credentials.
Do not modify application code, tests, fixtures, reports for the implementation task, schedules, databases, caches, queues, address libraries or production systems.
Do not treat user labels as verified facts or make PnL, profit, win-rate, wallet classification, clustering, CA linkage, holder, creator/Dev, complete-history or token-quality claims.
Do not add or substitute wallets, CAs or other inputs.
Do not print, persist, commit or quote raw payloads, transaction signatures, counterparties, token mints, credentials, credential-bearing URLs, arbitrary provider text or full exception text.
Do not use an ignored Harness run manifest as a declared audit input or as a replacement for tracked evidence.
Do not write outside the exact tracked write set.
